definition: the act or an instance of calling, inviting.
example: ಬಡವರ ಕ್ರಂದನ ಕೇಳಿ ರಾಜನು ಸಹಾಯಕ್ಕೆ ಬಂದನು.
example_en: Hearing the cry of the poor, the king came to help.

definition: a great flood or heavy rainfall.
example: ಆ ಊರಿನಲ್ಲಿ ಜಲಪ್ರಳಯ ಆಗಿ ಹಲವು ಮನೆಗಳು ಕೊಚ್ಚಿಹೋದವು.
example_en: A great flood occurred in that village and many houses were washed away.

definition: the tree Premna serratifolia (= P. integrifolia) of Verbenaceae family.
example_en: A Premna serratifolia tree has grown in the corner of the courtyard.

definition: a species of fish.
example: ಬೆಸ್ತರು ಬೆಳಿಗ್ಗೆ ನಗಲು ಮೀನನ್ನು ಮಾರುಕಟ್ಟೆಗೆ ತಂದರು.
example_en: The fishermen brought the nagalu fish to the market in the morning.

definition: a single hand.
example_en: She lifted the heavy basket with just a single hand.

definition: one who habitually steals; a thief.
example_en: The police caught that habitual thief.

definition: a man whose duty is to carry a message or to go on an errand for another; a messenger.
example_en: The king's messenger brought news from the border.

definition: to hurry busily or with much fuss and bother; to bustle; to hustle.
example: ಅವಳು ಬೇಗ ಬೇಗ ಗಡಬಡಿಸುತ್ತಾ ಕೆಲಸ ಮುಗಿಸಿದಳು.
example_en: She hurried busily and finished the work quickly.

definition: a strong desire for knowing; eagerness to learn; inquisitiveness.
example: ಅವನ ಜಿಜ್ಞಾಸನ ಅವನನ್ನು ಒಳ್ಳೆಯ ವಿದ್ವಾಂಸನನ್ನಾಗಿ ಮಾಡಿತು.
example_en: His inquisitiveness made him a good scholar.

definition: a piece; a fragment; a part or portion of a whole.
example_en: She picked up the fragment of the broken bangle.

definition: a kind of scab, a contagious skin disease, characterised by large, inflamed, painful, pus-filled swellings or boils.
example: ಆನೆಕಜ್ಜಿಯಿಂದ ಅವನ ಕಾಲಿನಲ್ಲಿ ದೊಡ್ಡ ಗುಳ್ಳೆಗಳು ಏಳುತ್ತವೆ.
example_en: Because of the contagious scab, large boils rise on his leg.

definition: a woman who reads; a reader.
example_en: That woman reader reads a book every day.

definition: a swollen part of the body; swelling.
example_en: A swelling formed on the leg due to an injury.

definition: love; affection.
example_en: The teacher's affection became a support to the disciples.

definition: zinc carbonate.
example_en: Zinc carbonate is used in making pigments.

definition: any of several pores in the skin.
example_en: Sweat came out through the pores of the skin.

definition: a small road across a main road; a cross road.
example: ಮುಖ್ಯ ರಸ್ತೆಯಿಂದ ಒಂದು ಅಡ್ಡರಸ್ತೆ ಹಳ್ಳಿಗೆ ಹೋಗುತ್ತದೆ.
example_en: A cross road from the main road leads to the village.

definition: a government department for collecting revenue.
example_en: The revenue department collects taxes.

definition: a bolt or bar with an eye at the end for a hook etc.; an eye-bolt.
example_en: They fitted an eye-bolt to the door and locked it.

definition: a depending on another.
example: ಅವನ ಬದುಕು ಸಂಪೂರ್ಣ ಪರಾಶ್ರಯ ಆಗಿ ಬಿಟ್ಟಿತು.
example_en: His life became entirely dependent on others.

definition: greatness, as in quantity, measure or degree; muchness.
example: ಈ ವರ್ಷದ ಮಳೆಯ ಬಹಳಿಕೆ ಎಲ್ಲರನ್ನೂ ಚಕಿತಗೊಳಿಸಿತು.
example_en: This year's abundance of rain surprised everyone.

definition: a kind of musical composition.
example_en: The singer sang the composition melodiously.

definition: an impression of one's palm, that is smeared with a colour, imprinted on a wall, esp. the one made by a girl who has just reached the stage of puberty.
example: ಗೋಡೆಯ ಮೇಲೆ ಅವಳ ಚೆಟ್ಟು ಇನ್ನೂ ಇತ್ತು.
example_en: Her palm-print imprint was still on the wall.

definition: fondness; affection; liking.
example: ಗುರುಗಳಿಗೆ ಆ ಶಿಷ್ಯನ ಮೇಲೆ ಮೆಚ್ಚಿಗೆ ಇತ್ತು.
example_en: The teacher had fondness for that disciple.

definition: to cut up or chop up (a thing) into very small pieces (as vegetables for cooking); to hash .
example_en: She chopped up the onions for cooking.

definition: a knot or knot-like part; node or hard lump on a tree where a branch grows.
example: ಮರದ ಗಣಕೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ಒಂದು ಹಕ್ಕಿ ಗೂಡು ಕಟ್ಟಿತ್ತು.
example_en: A bird had built a nest in the knot of the tree.

definition: substantial; nourishing (as food).
example_en: This food is very nourishing.

definition: the act, fact or an instance of wandering (aimlessly or uselessly).
example_en: The traveler who lost his way wandered aimlessly.

definition: to collect, and readily accept, knowledge from different sources, as the honeybee gathers nectar from different flowers.
example_en: The wise man gathers knowledge from everywhere.

definition: a wild elephant.
example_en: A wild elephant was breaking trees in the forest.

definition: a written statement, account, declaration, assertion or explanation.
example_en: The witness submitted his written statement to the court.

definition: to hold a conversation; to talk; to converse.
example: ಇಬ್ಬರು ಮಿತ್ರರು ಮರದ ಕೆಳಗೆ ಕುಳಿತು ಆಲಾಪಿಸಿದರು.
example_en: The two friends sat under the tree and conversed.

definition: a reply, response; a rejoinder.
example_en: No reply came from him to my question.

definition: to what place; towards which direction
example_en: Towards which direction are you going?

definition: or like a prism; prismoidal.
example_en: This piece of glass is prismoidal in shape.

definition: the one next to the last; penult.
example: ಪದ್ಯದ ಉಪಾಗ್ರ ಸಾಲಿನಲ್ಲಿ ಒಂದು ಪ್ರಾಸ ಪದವಿದೆ.
example_en: There is a rhyming word in the penultimate line of the poem.

definition: the state or quality of being incompatible, inconsistent or repugnant; repugnance; incompatibility; contradiction.
example_en: Inconsistency was clearly visible in his words.

definition: of similar kind, type; similar or comparable in all or most of the respects or resembling exactly (another).
example_en: His gait closely resembles his father's.

definition: a shout or shouting to proclaim or rejoice victory.
example: ಗೆಲುವಿನ ಸುದ್ದಿ ಬಂದೊಡನೆ ಬೀದಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ಗೆಲ್ಲುಲಿ ಎದ್ದಿತು.
example_en: As soon as the news of victory came, a victory shout arose in the street.

definition: an act of helping or assisting; a help; an aid.
example_en: We gave him a little help in his difficulty.

definition: followed closely or sincerely.
example_en: He followed his teacher's words closely and sincerely.

definition: to wander (with a purpose).
example_en: She wandered to the market with a purpose.

definition: the act, art of hunting.
example: ಅವನ ಬೇಟೆಗಾರಿಕೆ ಕಾಡಿನಲ್ಲಿ ಬೆಳಗಿನಿಂದ ಸಂಜೆಯವರೆಗೆ ನಡೆಯಿತು.
example_en: His hunting went on in the forest from morning till evening.

definition: the quality or condition of not being straight; crookedness.
example: ಆ ರಸ್ತೆಯ ಕೌಟಿಲ್ಯವು ವಾಹನಗಳಿಗೆ ಅಪಾಯವನ್ನು ಉಂಟುಮಾಡಿತು.
example_en: The crookedness of that road caused danger to vehicles.

definition: a plastic, dull-yellow substance secreted by bees for building cells; which is hard when cold, easily moulded when warm, cannot be dissolved in water, and is used for candles, modelling, etc.; beeswax.
example_en: They melted beeswax to make candles.

definition: dough made of wheat flour, a premix for making different food items.
example_en: Mother prepared the wheat dough mix in the morning.

definition: to collapse; to break down; to fall down or aside.
example_en: The bridge collapsed in the storm.

definition: want of physical strength.
example_en: Due to old age, physical weakness appeared in his body.

definition: a range of forests.
example_en: There is a vast range of forests at the foot of the hill.

definition: either of a pair of connected metal rings that can be locked about the wrists, as in restraining a prisoner; a hand-cuff.
example_en: The police put handcuffs on the thief's hands.

definition: to plunder; to strip of everything valuable by force or fraud; to despoil.
example_en: The robbers plundered the house.

definition: a carving on metal, wood, stone, etc.
example: ಆ ಬೆಳ್ಳಿ ತಟ್ಟೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ಸುಂದರ ನಕಾಸೆಕೆಲಸ ಇತ್ತು.
example_en: There was beautiful carving on that silver plate.

definition: the work, duty or occupation of a teacher.
example_en: She carries out the work of a teacher with love.

definition: an elephant.
example_en: The king's elephant marched ahead of the army.

definition: a war; battle.
example: ಎರಡು ರಾಜ್ಯಗಳ ನಡುವೆ ಭೀಕರ ಹೊಯಿಕುಟ್ಟು ನಡೆಯಿತು.
example_en: A fierce war took place between the two kingdoms.

definition: additional income; gain or profit received from additional, auxiliary activity, business.
example_en: He sells milk in the evening for additional income.

definition: the rules of phonology; phonological rules.
example_en: The linguists studied the phonological rules.

definition: second; second-born.
example_en: Her second-born daughter is very clever.

definition: water used for plants.
example_en: The farmer let the water for the crops flow into the field.

definition: a very young child.
example_en: The very young child was playing in the yard.

definition: a brahmaṇa belonging to or from Karahāḍa country.
example_en: The Karahāḍa brahmin men of the town had come to the temple festival.

definition: a conqueror of enemy force.
example_en: That king became famous as a conqueror of the enemy force.

definition: to talk much, incessantly, and foolishly; chatter; to prate.
example_en: The old man chattered on foolishly by himself all day.

definition: not confining to aesthetic requirement; not artistic.
example_en: That picture was made in a not-so-artistic style.

definition: a flute-player.
example: ಆ ವೈಣವಿಕ ಸಭೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ಮಧುರವಾಗಿ ಕೊಳಲು ನುಡಿಸಿದನು.
example_en: That flute-player played the flute sweetly in the assembly.

definition: to cause to leak, drop or trickle.
example_en: Water was made to trickle from the cracked pot.

definition: the behaviour of a person trying to get, by affected manners, others attention or admiration; showiness; dandyism; coquetry.
example_en: People laughed seeing her showy, affected manner.

definition: (used in pl.) sparks being thrown off by a fire in different directions.
example_en: Sparks flew off from the fire in every direction.

definition: a clever, intelligent man.
example: ಆ ಶ್ಯಾಣ್ಯಾ ಎಲ್ಲ ಸಮಸ್ಯೆಗಳಿಗೂ ಪರಿಹಾರ ಹುಡುಕಿದನು.
example_en: That clever man found a solution to every problem.

definition: not exact, hence, not reliable.
example_en: That calculation is inexact and cannot be trusted.

definition: to include, contain (within oneself, one's sphere, range, jurisdiction, etc.).
example_en: This kingdom contains many provinces.

definition: a foolish or stupid man; an idiot.
example: ಊರಿನ ಜನ ಅವನನ್ನು ಬೆಳ್ಪ ಎಂದು ಗೇಲಿ ಮಾಡಿದರು.
example_en: The townspeople mocked him as a fool.

definition: the evergreen plant Thea sinensis (= Camellia thea, = C. sinensis) of Theaceae family.
example_en: There were rows of tea plants in that garden.

definition: the early stage of youth.
example_en: The boys in early youth were engrossed in play.

definition: a leather pouch for cartridges.
example_en: The soldier kept the cartridges in his leather pouch.

definition: the act or power of compelling or coercing; compulsion; coersion.
example_en: The government collected tax through compulsion.

definition: amounting to thirty two.
example: ಆ ಚೀಲದಲ್ಲಿ ಬತ್ತೀಸ ಕಿಲೋಗ್ರಾಂ ಅಕ್ಕಿ ಇತ್ತು.
example_en: There were thirty-two kilograms of rice in that sack.

definition: a short stabbing weapon; a dagger.
example_en: The old dagger is now in the museum.

definition: husked grain of the grass Oryza sativa, used as food, rice.
example_en: The farmer brought rice home from the field.

definition: a bed or couch.
example: ಅಜ್ಜಿ ಹಕ್ಕೆಯ ಮೇಲೆ ಕುಳಿತು ಕಥೆ ಹೇಳಿದಳು.
example_en: Grandmother sat on the couch and told a story.

definition: not partial or biased; fair; just; impartial.
example_en: The judge gave the verdict impartially.

definition: (mus.) name of a rāga (musical mode).
example: ಗಾಯಕಿ ಶುದ್ಧವಾಹಿನಿ ರಾಗವನ್ನು ಬಹಳ ಸೊಗಸಾಗಿ ಹಾಡಿದಳು.
example_en: The singer sang the Śuddhavāhini rāga very beautifully.

definition: a flat rectangular raised piece forming a part of the surface of a wall, door, etc.; a panel.
example_en: A beautiful panel was carved on the door.

definition: he who is or keeps moving.
example_en: Moving animals wander about in search of food.

definition: a very adverse situation.
example_en: After the war, the country faced a very adverse situation.

definition: transparent, colourless or slightly tinged quartz; a crystal.
example_en: Geologists studied the properties of the crystal.

definition: a small ball, tablet, capsule, etc. of medicine to be swallowed whole; a pill.
example: ವೈದ್ಯರು ದಿನಕ್ಕೆ ಎರಡು ಗುಟಿಕೆಗಳನ್ನು ನುಂಗಲು ಹೇಳಿದರು.
example_en: The doctor asked to swallow two pills a day.

definition: the quality or fact of being certain; certainty.
example_en: The certainty of this news has still not been obtained.

definition: an unobstructed or unrestrained movement.
example_en: The river water was flowing in an unobstructed movement.

definition: a selfish man who takes advantage of an opportunity without regard for basic principles; an opportunist.
example_en: The opportunist took advantage of the opportunity and gained profit.

definition: a structure whose construction is very good or extraordinary.
example_en: The extraordinary structure of that temple astonished onlookers.

definition: to get something fastened, joined, repaired with or as with stitches.
example_en: The tailor got the torn cloth mended with stitches.

definition: a dry curry used as a side dish with cakes.
example_en: Mother served a dry curry along with the dosa.

definition: a woven material, either stitched or not, used to wear on or cover the body; a cloth.
example_en: She wore a new cloth.

definition: to become coagulated, solidified.
example_en: As the hot milk cooled, it coagulated.

definition: to become greater in size, number, intensity, etc.
example_en: The riot in the town kept growing in intensity.

definition: to become deadened, insensible caused by obstruction in blood circulation.
example_en: His legs became numb from the cold.

definition: a large metal vessel for storing or boiling water or other liquids; a vat; a barrel.
example: ಅಡುಗೆ ಮನೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ದೊಡ್ಡ ಕಡಾಯ ನೀರಿನಿಂದ ತುಂಬಿತ್ತು.
example_en: The large vat in the kitchen was filled with water.

definition: a kind of tree.
example_en: The hommara tree was giving shade in the yard.

definition: the plant Musa paradisiaca of Musaceae family.
example_en: The garden is full of banana plants.

definition: the tree Butea frondosa of Papilionaceae family.
example: ತೋಟದಲ್ಲಿ ಮುಕ್ತಕ ಮರ ಕೆಂಪು ಹೂ ಬಿಟ್ಟಿತ್ತು.
example_en: The muktaka tree in the garden had bloomed with red flowers.

definition: easily set on fire; that will burn readily or quickly; inflammable.
example_en: Dry grass is easily set on fire.

definition: the quality of being coarse, rough; roughness (as of the surface of something).
example: ಈ ಕಲ್ಲಿನ ಪುಱುಕು ಕೈಗೆ ನೋವು ಕೊಡುತ್ತದೆ.
example_en: The roughness of this stone hurts the hand.

definition: a fall of rain with splashes; a splashing of rain.
example_en: The splashing rain that came with the wind rushed into the house.

definition: a man in happy, safe condition; a happy man.
example_en: The happy man of the village used to help everyone.

definition: focussing one's thoughts.
example_en: The student with a focused mind succeeded in the exam.

definition: a mark of punctuation (?) placed after a sentence, word, etc. indicating a direct question or expressing doubt, uncertainty, etc.; a question mark; an interrogation mark.
example_en: A question mark should be placed at the end of a question.

definition: a stoneway over an underground channel to walk on.
example: ತೋಟದ ಒಳಗೆ ಕಲ್ಸಂಕ ದಾಟಿ ಮುಂದೆ ಹೋದೆವು.
example_en: We crossed the stoneway over the underground channel and went ahead inside the garden.

definition: to bring together as to make one; to combine into a whole; to unite.
example: ಎರಡು ತಂಡಗಳನ್ನು ಒಂದಾಗಿಸಿ ಹೊಸ ಸಂಘಟನೆ ಮಾಡಿದರು.
example_en: They united the two teams and formed a new organization.

definition: having a defect or flaw; faulty; defective.
example_en: It turned out that the goods were defective.

definition: to present a riddle to another for solving.
example_en: The grandfather was smiling while presenting a riddle to the grandchild.

definition: having little or no hair on the scalp; bald.
example_en: The bald old man was sitting in the sun.

definition: a hump-backed man.
example_en: The hump-backed man was walking with his back bent.

definition: an unfortunate person.
example_en: That unfortunate person did not get any job.

definition: to turn oneself around one's axis.
example_en: While playing, the child was happily spinning around on its own axis.

definition: one's mother's mother; a maternal grand-mother.
example_en: Her maternal grandmother lived in the village.

definition: a good-looking man; a man of pleasing appearance.
example_en: All the villagers admired that good-looking man (canna).

definition: a sinister, wicked deed or indulgence.
example: ಅವನ ದುರ್ವಿಲಸಿತದಿಂದ ಊರಿಗೆ ಕೆಟ್ಟ ಹೆಸರು ಬಂತು.
example_en: His sinister deed brought a bad name to the village.

definition: a chain of closely situated mountains.
example_en: There is a long chain of mountains in the Western Ghats.

definition: a man who opposes, fights against, etc.
example_en: It is not easy to defeat a man who fights against you.

definition: to walk, run or move around (something); to circumambulate.
example_en: The devotees followed the tradition of circumambulating the temple.

definition: a being disloyal to one's religion; transgression of religious laws or commandments.
example_en: No one will forgive betrayal of one's religion.

definition: every one of two or more considered separately; each.
example_en: A book was given to each of the students.

definition: a solution which can still solve the soluble; an unsaturated solution.
example_en: They prepared an unsaturated solution in the laboratory.

definition: the part of the earth's surface directly above the place of origin or focus, of an earthquake; the epicentre.
example_en: The epicentre of the earthquake was under the sea.

definition: a place affording protection, as from the elements or danger; a shelter.
example_en: The police station was in the middle of the town.

definition: the part of the body on which one walks; a foot.
example_en: His foot has been injured.

definition: a thing for sleeping or resting on; a piece of furniture consisting usu. of a bedstead, bedspring, mattress, and bedding; a bed.
example: ಕೋಣೆಯ ಮೂಲೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ಒಂದು ಹೊಸ ಸಜ್ಜೆ ಇಡಲಾಗಿತ್ತು.
example_en: A new bed had been placed in the corner of the room.

definition: sexual pleasure derived from looking at.
example_en: His gaze of sexual pleasure from looking disgusted her.

definition: the plant Talauma mutabilis of Magnoliaceae family.
example: ಅರಣ್ಯದಲ್ಲಿ ಹಳದಿಗಾರ ಮರವು ಹಳದಿ ಬಣ್ಣದ ಹೂಗಳನ್ನು ಬಿಟ್ಟಿತ್ತು.
example_en: In the forest the Talauma mutabilis tree had borne yellow flowers.

definition: disdainful pride; haughtiness.
example_en: His haughtiness irritated everyone.

definition: the medium sized, evergreen tree Olea dioca of Oleaceae family.
example: ಆ ಬೆಟ್ಟದ ತಪ್ಪಲಿನಲ್ಲಿ ಹೆಕ್ಕೆರಕಲು ಮರಗಳು ಹೇರಳವಾಗಿವೆ.
example_en: Hekkerakalu trees are abundant at the foot of that hill.

definition: the act or process of excluding exclusion.
example_en: His name had been excluded from the list.

definition: to get a passport or a permit (from the concerned authority).
example_en: Before the journey, he obtained a permit from the office.

definition: sensuous enjoyments.
example_en: Those interested in sensuous enjoyments lose their peace.

definition: the wife of a prince, heir-apparent.
example_en: The prince's wife participated in the palace festival.

definition: she who is self-satisfied; a self-satisfied woman.
example_en: She lives as a self-satisfied woman.

definition: a huge, monstrous ghost.
example_en: It is said a huge monstrous ghost appeared near the hill.

definition: a taste different from another.
example: ಈ ಸಾರಿನಲ್ಲಿ ಭಿನ್ನರುಚಿ ಇದೆ ಎಂದು ಅವಳು ಹೇಳಿದಳು.
example_en: She said this curry has a different taste.

definition: a well twisted twine.
example_en: He tied the bag with a well twisted twine.

definition: of white colour; white.
example_en: She had worn a white-coloured saree.

definition: the tree Semecarpus travancorica (= S.anacardium) of Anacardiaceae family.
example_en: The wild cashew tree grows at the foot of the hill.

definition: a cord made by intertwisting two or more strands together.
example: ಪುರಿನೇಣ್ ಬಲವಾಗಿ ಹೆಣೆದಿದ್ದ ಕಾರಣ ಬೇಗ ಹರಿಯಲಿಲ್ಲ.
example_en: Since the intertwisted cord was woven strongly, it did not tear quickly.

definition: the grass Andropogon bicolour.
example: ಹೊಲದ ಬದಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ಯಾವನಾಳ ಹುಲ್ಲು ದಟ್ಟವಾಗಿ ಬೆಳೆದಿತ್ತು.
example_en: The yāvanāḷa grass had grown thickly along the edge of the field.

definition: the feet of Viṣṇu.
example_en: The devotees sat meditating on the feet of Vishnu.

definition: to become legally binding, valid or enforceable.
example: ಒಪ್ಪಂದಕ್ಕೆ ಇಬ್ಬರೂ ಸಹಿ ಹಾಕಿದ ಮೇಲೆ ಅದು ಊರ್ಜಿತವಾಯಿತು.
example_en: After both parties signed the agreement, it became legally binding.

definition: any such gland or hormone, as the thyroid or its thyroxine; an endocrine gland.
example_en: The thyroid is an important endocrine gland.

definition: to become inflated; to swell.
example: ಬಿಸಿಲಿನಲ್ಲಿ ಟ್ಯೂಬು ಹೊಟ್ಟಳಿಸಿ ಒಡೆಯುವ ಸಾಧ್ಯತೆ ಇತ್ತು.
example_en: In the sun, there was a chance the tube would swell and burst.

definition: to become thin; to wane.
example_en: During the drought, the crop kept withering and dried up.

definition: to miss or err in following, the regular order.
example_en: The clerk erred in the order of files and created confusion.

definition: sight - a) a view; look; glimpse; b) the act of seeing; perception by the eyes.
example_en: She understood everything in a single glance.

definition: the activity or profession of a trader.
example_en: In that town, trading was the main livelihood.

definition: a man or boy whose work is tending, feeding, and currying horses; a groom.
example_en: That groom gave water to the horses to drink.

definition: to be neatly arranged; to become tidy.
example_en: After cleaning, the house became neat and tidy.

definition: a man who carves statues, idols, etc. in stones; a sculptor.
example: ಶಿಲ್ಪಕಾರ ಕಲ್ಲಿನಲ್ಲಿ ಸುಂದರ ದೇವರ ಮೂರ್ತಿ ಕೆತ್ತಿದನು.
example_en: The sculptor carved a beautiful idol of God in stone.

definition: heavy security; the condition of being guarded highly vigilantly.
example_en: Since there is heavy security at the border, no one can intrude.

definition: irony that is inherent in speeches or a situation of a drama and is understood by the audience but not grasped by the characters in the play.
example: ಆ ನಾಟಕದಲ್ಲಿ ನಾಟಕೀಯ ವ್ಯಂಗ್ಯ ಪ್ರೇಕ್ಷಕರಿಗೆ ಚೆನ್ನಾಗಿ ಅರ್ಥವಾಯಿತು.
example_en: The audience clearly understood the dramatic irony in that play.

definition: being low; inferior; humble.
example_en: He was born in a humble condition.

definition: a man whose behaviour or conduct is strange or abnormal; an odd, queer man.
example: ಆ ವಿಕ್ಷಿಪ್ತ ರಸ್ತೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ಒಬ್ಬನೇ ಮಾತನಾಡುತ್ತಾ ನಡೆಯುತ್ತಿದ್ದನು.
example_en: That odd man was walking on the road talking alone.

definition: to ignore; to neglect.
example_en: He neglected his duty.

definition: not properly serious or sensible; silly and light-minded; joking, trifling; frivolous.
example_en: Everyone laughed at his frivolous words.

definition: a going out; exit; departure.
example_en: The exit gate is on the left side at the airport.

definition: a small dagger.
example_en: That thief had a small dagger in his hand.

definition: a slapping on another's cheek.
example_en: He got a slap on the cheek for telling a lie.

definition: to fill with.
example_en: The room filled with smoke.

definition: to push, project, protrude in between or across.
example_en: He pushed his hand in between the row.

definition: the act of forcing or compelling; compulsion; duress.
example_en: They obtained his signature through compulsion.

definition: a birth on the earth.
example: ಪ್ರತಿ ಜೀವಿಯ ನೆಲವುಟ್ಟು ಒಂದು ಅದ್ಭುತ ಘಟನೆ.
example_en: The earthly birth of every living being is a wondrous event.

definition: to place in such and such a position, state, predicament, relation, etc.; to put.
example_en: She put the flower in the basket.

definition: a man whose conduct conforms to approved social standards; a respectable man.
example: ಆ ಊರಿನಲ್ಲಿ ಅವನೊಬ್ಬ ಮರ್ಯಾದಸ್ತ ವ್ಯಕ್ತಿ ಎಂದು ಹೆಸರಾಗಿದ್ದಾನೆ.
example_en: He is known as a respectable man in that town.

definition: a religious sacrifice in which the life of a human being is offered to propitiate a god.
example: ಪುರಾತನ ಕಾಲದಲ್ಲಿ ನರಮೇಧ ಒಂದು ಕ್ರೂರ ಆಚರಣೆಯಾಗಿತ್ತು.
example_en: In ancient times, human sacrifice was a cruel practice.

definition: the state in which the nervous system is affected by an intoxicant, as alcohol; intoxication.
example_en: Because of the intoxication from drinking too much, he could not walk.

definition: a close relative.
example: ಅವನು ನನ್ನ ಕಡುನಂಟ, ಅವನ ಮನೆ ನಮ್ಮ ಮನೆಯ ಪಕ್ಕದಲ್ಲೇ ಇದೆ.
example_en: He is my close relative; his house is right next to ours.

definition: to compel - a) to force or constrain, as to do something; b) to get or bring about by force.
example_en: The police compelled the culprit to tell the truth.

definition: causing fear; frightful; terrible; horrible.
example_en: Seeing the frightful form, the child began to cry.

definition: he who knows everything; an all-knowing man.
example: ಆ ಸಂತನನ್ನು ಜನರು ಸರ್ವಜ್ಞ ಎಂದು ಕರೆಯುತ್ತಿದ್ದರು.
example_en: People used to call that saint an all-knowing man.

definition: a single or secluded room in a building.
example_en: He was sitting alone in the secluded room.

definition: a dividing or being divided; separation.
example_en: The division of property caused a dispute in the family.

definition: vividness, fluency or gracefulness of speech.
example_en: The vividness of speech in his talk captivated everyone.

definition: an idol of a bull, having wheels, used by children as a toy.
example_en: They gave the child a wheeled bull toy to play with.

definition: strong; durable; withstanding the physical wear and tear or mental agony.
example: ಆ ಧಡ ಹಗ್ಗ ಎಷ್ಟು ಎಳೆದರೂ ತುಂಡಾಗಲಿಲ್ಲ.
example_en: That strong rope did not break however much it was pulled.

definition: of the nature of cheating; tending to deceive (another or others).
example: ಆ ವ್ಯಾಪಾರಿಯ ಠಕ್ಕ ಬುದ್ಧಿಯಿಂದ ಗ್ರಾಹಕರು ಮೋಸ ಹೋದರು.
example_en: Because of that merchant's deceitful nature, the customers were cheated.

definition: a disease of the intestines caused by the vital air in the body.
example_en: He got a disease of the intestines and his belly swelled up.

definition: a wall enclosing a building and its surrounding place.
example_en: There was a sturdy enclosing wall around the palace.

definition: the rear or hinder part of anything; back.
example: ಬಸ್ಸಿನ ಪಿಂತು ಭಾಗದಲ್ಲಿ ಆಸನಗಳು ಖಾಲಿ ಇದ್ದವು.
example_en: The seats at the rear part of the bus were empty.

definition: a sub-caste among weavers.
example_en: People of the Padmasali sub-caste are skilled in weaving sarees.

definition: the large vulture Gyps bengalensis of Acciptridae family, with bald-head, naked neck, white back and shoulder, large wings, short but strong curved beak, black legs, that feeds on dead animals; Indian white-backed vulure.
example_en: The vulture descended on the dead cow.

definition: reciprocal state or relationship; mutual action, dependence, etc.; reciprocity.
example: ಆ ಇಬ್ಬರ ನಡುವೆ ಆಳವಾದ ಅನ್ಯೋನ್ಯತೆ ಇದೆ.
example_en: There is a deep mutual bond between those two.

definition: a door-keeper.
example_en: A door-keeper stood guard at the palace gate.

definition: a thing stolen (usu. for selling it to another).
example_en: The police detected the stolen goods.

definition: a white, ductile metallic element, atomic number 13, chem. symbol Al, with good resistance to corrosion, used as a basis for many light alloys; aluminium.
example_en: Aluminium is a lightweight metal.

definition: the point toward which something faces or the line along which something moves or lies; a direction.
example: ಅವನು ಯಾವ ಗೋಂಟಿನಲ್ಲಿ ನಡೆದನೋ ನನಗೆ ಗೊತ್ತಿಲ್ಲ.
example_en: I do not know in which direction he walked.

definition: lacking refinement, culture or elegance; uncouth, boorish, coarse, vulgar, etc.
example_en: His speech was full of coarseness.

definition: mounted; risen; ascended.
example: ಅವನ ಪ್ರಭಾವ ಎಲ್ಲಾ ಕಡೆ ರೂಢಿತವಾಗಿ ಹರಡಿತು.
example_en: His influence spread, mounting everywhere.

definition: a length of thick rope.
example_en: They used a thick rope to draw water from the well.

definition: the work to be done.
example_en: He has a lot of work to be done today.

definition: gentle wind.
example_en: The gentle evening wind was pleasant to the mind.

definition: the work or profession of a tailor or cobbler.
example_en: His family has been doing the tailor's trade for generations.

definition: oxygen, the most essential thing for a living being.
example_en: Living beings cannot survive without oxygen.

definition: the profession of a painter.
example_en: He chose the profession of a painter as his livelihood.

definition: to eliminate completely; to erase; to destroy.
example_en: He completely erased the old debt.

definition: (an infection) to turn septic by absorbing pathogenic micro-organisms and their products into the bloodstream.
example_en: The wound turned septic due to lack of proper care.

definition: a fighting with the fists.
example_en: A fistfight started between two people on the street.

definition: to change one's place; to move; to go, walk, flow, etc.
example_en: The cart moved slowly on the road.

definition: a kind of footwear used for sliding on snow.
example: ಪ್ರವಾಸಿಗರು ಜಾರುಮೆಟ್ಟು ಧರಿಸಿ ಮಂಜಿನ ಮೇಲೆ ಜಾರಿದರು.
example_en: The tourists wore snow shoes and slid on the snow.

definition: a bald head.
example_en: He put a cap on his bald head.

definition: a soldier (as the person who earns his livelihood by fighting).
example_en: As a soldier, he fought in many battles.

definition: a pleased feeling; enjoyment; delight; pleasure.
example: ಮಗನ ಯಶಸ್ಸನ್ನು ಕಂಡು ತಂದೆಗೆ ಮೋದ ಉಂಟಾಯಿತು.
example_en: Seeing his son's success, the father felt delight.

definition: that is to be kept or placed.
example_en: These documents are to be kept in a safe place.

definition: an unfortunate man.
example_en: That unfortunate man suffered hardship all his life.

definition: the chief commanding officer of a military force.
example_en: The chief commanding officer gave orders to the whole army.

definition: one who, by exercising muscles, builds a strong body;
example: ಅಂಗಸಾಧಕನು ಪ್ರತಿದಿನ ವ್ಯಾಯಾಮ ಮಾಡಿ ಬಲಿಷ್ಠ ದೇಹ ಪಡೆದನು.
example_en: The bodybuilder exercised daily and gained a strong body.

definition: a group of people; a multitude.
example_en: A large multitude had gathered in front of the temple.

definition: an ostentatious display; pomp.
example_en: They made a great ostentatious display at the wedding.

definition: shining brightly; lustrous.
example_en: The brightly shining gold ornament glittered in the sunlight.

definition: to cause to come in between; to make (someone) interfere.
example_en: He made a third person interfere in the quarrel between the two.

definition: (fig.) sharp, caustic remark.
example_en: Her sharp, caustic tongue hurt many people's feelings.

definition: an abnormal infiltration and excess accumulation of serous fluid in connective tissue or in a serous cavity, esp. with swelling the belly; dropsy; oedema.
example_en: The doctor detected dropsy.

definition: a piece of furniture to sit on; a seat.
example_en: The teacher was seated on the seat.

definition: that which covers or envelops; a cover; a wrapper.
example_en: She covered the baby with a warm wrapper.

definition: the act or process of learning.
example_en: Children's learning begins at school.

definition: a man who sells or deals with manure.
example: ಸಗಣಿಗ ಪ್ರತಿ ಬೆಳಿಗ್ಗೆ ಗೊಬ್ಬರ ಮಾರಲು ಹೊರಡುತ್ತಿದ್ದನು.
example_en: The manure dealer used to set out to sell manure every morning.

definition: to fear; to be afraid of.
example_en: The boy was frightened by the thunder.

definition: the first letter and the first vowel of the Kannaḍa alphabet;
example_en: The first letter of the Kannada alphabet is 'a'.

definition: the sun, as a lover of lotus flower.
example_en: The poet praised the sun, the lover of the lotus, and wrote a poem.

definition: to flow in stream.
example_en: After the rain the stream flowed in full spate.

definition: commended; praised; complimented; congratulated; felicitated.
example_en: His achievement was commended and praised by everyone.

definition: second; second-born.
example_en: He is the second-born son of this family.

definition: what is left when a part is taken away; remainder; balance.
example: ಖರ್ಚಾದ ಮೇಲೆ ಇನ್ನೂ ಸ್ವಲ್ಪ ಉಳುಮೆ ಇದೆ.
example_en: After the expenses, there is still some remainder left.

definition: to put a rope around one's neck as to catch; to catch in a snare; to trap.
example_en: The hunter put a rope snare around the rabbit's neck.

definition: the ocean.
example_en: The ship sailed far across the ocean.

definition: a sharp, pointed horn (of an animal as cattle).
example_en: The ox poked the tree with its sharp pointed horn.

definition: the fire-place in a bathroom for heating water.
example: ಅಮ್ಮ ಸ್ನಾನದ ಮನೆಯ ನೀರೊಲೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ನೀರು ಕಾಯಿಸಿದಳು.
example_en: Mother heated water in the bathroom fireplace.

definition: any of the external object, experience, that are subject to the mind.
example_en: If the mind gets caught in external objects, peace will not be found.

definition: water in the form of gas or vapour; steam.
example_en: Steam was rising from the hot water.

definition: the state or quality of being incomplete; incompleteness; want of something to be perfect; deficiency.
example: ಆ ಕೆಲಸದ ಅರ್ಧತನವನ್ನು ನೋಡಿ ಎಲ್ಲರೂ ಬೇಸರಪಟ್ಟರು.
example_en: Everyone was disappointed to see the incompleteness of that work.

definition: to be separated, severed.
example_en: Those threads got severed when pulled.

definition: a formal request in writing addressed to a judicial authority requesting for redressing, compensation etc.; a petition.
example_en: The officials examined the petition.

definition: to make a picture in colours applied to a surface with a paint; to paint.
example_en: The artist painted a picture on the wall.

definition: a vessel used to boil water; a boiler.

example_en: In his old age, he began to have knee pain.

definition: to become free; to be released from bondage or another's authority, obligation, arbitrary power, etc.
example_en: He became free from the bondage.

definition: to hop - a) to make a short leap or leaps on one foot; b) to move by leaping or springing on both (or all) feet at once, as a bird, frog, etc.
example_en: The player hopped near the line.

definition: to engage in a discussion or argument; to discuss; to debate.
example_en: The two scholars discussed and debated about the topic.

definition: a container, case or receptacle, usu. rectangular, of wood, metal, etc., and often with a hinged lid or removable cover; a box.
example_en: They had kept the worship materials in a box.

definition: the quality of being astute or sharp in practical matters; shrewdness.

example_en: His shrewdness while making the deal proved useful to everyone.

definition: worthy of praise; laudable.

example_en: Everyone praised his service as laudable.

definition: (grammatically not an acceptable compound) a protein readily turned into gelatine.
example_en: This substance has a high amount of protein that turns into gelatine.

definition: to rub or scrape slightly, as with the fingernails, to relieve itching; to scratch.
example_en: He scratched the spot where the mosquito had bitten him.

definition: a man who specialises in a particular field of study, professional work, etc.; a specialist.
example: ಹೃದಯ ಶಸ್ತ್ರಚಿಕಿತ್ಸೆಗೆ ಆ ಆಸ್ಪತ್ರೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ವಿಶೇಷಜ್ಞ ಇದ್ದಾನೆ.
example_en: There is a specialist for heart surgery in that hospital.

definition: a man who is wholly occupied or engrossed in.
example_en: He sat wholly engrossed in music.

definition: the chequered cloth or board on which the game of dice is played.
example: ಮುದುಕರು ಲತ್ತದ ಮೇಲೆ ಕುಳಿತು ಪಗಡೆ ಆಡಿದರು.
example_en: The elders sat on the dice board and played chess-like game.

definition: a man not related to, not form a part of, a group, family, village, community, etc.
example: ಆ ಪೊರಗಣ ಮನುಷ್ಯನಿಗೆ ಊರಿನ ಪದ್ಧತಿ ಗೊತ್ತಿಲ್ಲ.
example_en: That outsider does not know the village's customs.

definition: not surely or certainly known; questionable; problematic; b) not sure or certain in knowledge; doubtful; uncertain.
example_en: That news is still uncertain.

definition: to be tamed and domesticated.
example_en: That horse was well tamed for riding.

definition: to be satiated, satisfied.
example_en: After the meal, he was satiated.

definition: excessive work; a huge work load.
example_en: This household work has become an excessive burden for me.

definition: the act of scattering in drops; a sprinkling.

example_en: The sprinkling of flower-water perfumed the whole room.

definition: easily bent or twisted; flexible; pliant; soft; supple.
example: ಈ ಎಲೆ ಸ್ಪರ್ಶಕ್ಕೆ ಮೆದು ಆಗಿ ಅನಿಸಿತು.
example_en: This leaf felt soft to the touch.

definition: the act of cutting, severing.
example_en: The cutting of the tree branch was easy.

definition: a kind of spicy pudding.
example_en: Everyone liked the spicy pudding on the festival day.

definition: to reduce in value or price.
example_en: The shopkeeper reduced the price of the saree.

definition: a discourteous, disobedient or rude man.
example_en: Everyone complained that he was a rude, disobedient man.

definition: to make a regular and repeated circuit of an area, town.
example_en: The soldiers kept watch all night.

definition: the beak (that is not open) of a bird.
example_en: The parrot held the seed with its beak.

definition: indecent or offensive speech.
example: ಅವನ ಬಾಯಿಂದ ಕೊಳೆಮಾತು ಬಂದಾಗ ಎಲ್ಲರೂ ಸಿಟ್ಟಾದರು.
example_en: Everyone got angry when indecent speech came from his mouth.

definition: to utter a shrill, loud, piercing cry in fright, pain, etc.; to scream; to shriek.
example_en: Seeing the snake, the child shrieked in fright.

definition: a storing of food; food-stocking.

definition: a sound produced in swallowing morsels; 2 ) a sound imitating this.
example_en: The child drank the milk with a gulping sound.

definition: to make a person become mad, insane.
example_en: That incident made him go mad.

definition: a kind of game-catching net.
example_en: The hunter caught the birds with the game-catching net.

definition: a mathematical expression denoting only magnitude but no direction, as velocity; scalar quantity.
example: ವೇಗವು ಒಂದು ಅದಿಶಪರಿಮಾಣ, ಏಕೆಂದರೆ ಅದಕ್ಕೆ ದಿಕ್ಕು ಇಲ್ಲ.
example_en: Speed is a scalar quantity, because it has no direction.

definition: to become ripe; to ripen.
example_en: The crop in the field has ripened and is ready for harvest.

definition: a heap; a multitude; a pile.
example_en: Due to the rain, a heap of garbage collected by the roadside.

definition: (pl.) demerit and merit (usu. of the same person, system, etc.).
example_en: People discussed his merits and demerits.

definition: having been included, enclosed.
example_en: That matter had been included and enclosed within the agreement.

definition: the table land by the side or around a mountain.
example_en: There were huts near the table land around the mountain.

definition: a small axe, with a flat, crescent shaped blade, mainly used in war; a sort of battle-axe.
example_en: The warrior confronted the enemy with a battle-axe.

definition: the quail Perdicula asiatica of Phasianidae family, with brown body and wings, black and grey stripes on the breast, short grey beak, short tail, that nests on the ground; jungle bush-quail.
example: ಬುಱುಲೆ ಪೊದೆಯ ಬಳಿ ನೆಲದ ಮೇಲೆ ಗೂಡು ಕಟ್ಟಿತು.
example_en: The jungle bush-quail built its nest on the ground near the bush.

definition: (physiol.) bringing inward to a central part, esp, designating nerves that transmit impulses to the central nervous system, as to the brain; afferent.
example_en: Afferent nerves transmit signals to the brain.

definition: to lose colour, brilliance, freshness or strength; to wither; to wane; to fade.
example_en: The flower withered quickly due to the heat.

definition: to come forth; to be emitted from within; to come or go out.
example_en: Water came forth from the crevice of the rock.

definition: to evade or avoid doing (something that should be done); to shirk.
example_en: He shirked the work and avoided doing it.

definition: he who establishes, institutes, erects, installs (as an idol of a deity).
example_en: He is the founder of this institution.

definition: proper; fitting; seemly; right.
example_en: This dress is proper for the ceremony.

definition: that is compounded with another.
example_en: That word is compounded with another word.

definition: to cause to become modest; to make another feel shy.
example_en: His words of praise made the girl feel shy.

definition: a payment of fixed sum of money every month for sustenance.

definition: to come into association with; to join; to associate (oneself) with.
example_en: He associated himself with good friends.

definition: the cardinal number seventy; 70.

example_en: This year grandfather turned seventy years old.

definition: the excessive indulgence in sexual pleasures; intemperance; debauchery.
example_en: Immersed in debauchery, he lost his health.

definition: a container made of interwoven cane, bamboo splits, strips of wood, etc.; a basket.
example_en: Grandmother filled the basket with fruits.

definition: the Hemp Hibiscus cannabinus of Malvaceae family.
example_en: Hemp hibiscus plants had grown along the edge of the field.

definition: a man who praises (another) highly (either as a part of one's duty as in a king's court or as a staunch believer in a god or for gaining favour); an extoller; an eulogist.
example_en: That eulogist praised the king in the assembly.

definition: the quality of being clean; spotlessness; stainlessness.
example_en: Everyone admired the purity of her mind.

definition: to utter a deep sound expressing pain, distress; to groan.

definition: an arch. coin equal to one twentieth of a Haṇa.

example_en: In those days, nothing could be bought for one small coin.

definition: a hide-and-seek play of children.

example_en: In the evening, the children spent time playing hide-and-seek.

definition: a getting of a job.
example_en: After getting his degree, he obtained a job.

definition: any of the five jointed parts projecting from the palm of the hand; a finger.
example_en: A ring was put on her finger.

definition: to run afar.
example_en: The boy ran far off in fear.

definition: to cause to enter into; to make something go in.
example_en: He made the cattle enter the shed.

definition: finely powdered sugar.
example_en: Mother mixed finely powdered sugar into the tea.

definition: to cause to stretch forward; to put against (as to obstruct the way).
example_en: The soldiers put logs across to obstruct the enemy's path.

definition: to cause to move.
example_en: The clerk caused the goods to be moved.

definition: the cutting edge of a sword.
example_en: The blacksmith sharpened the cutting edge of the new sword.

definition: a percussion instrument consisting of big hollow cylinder with a membrane stretched tightly over one end, the other being closed, played by beating with sticks; a huge drum.
example_en: The huge drum sounded at the start of the battle.

definition: temperature that is moderate; luke-warmness.
example_en: Luke-warm water is good for bathing.

definition: the luminous band of stars stretching across the heavens; the galaxy; the milky-way.
example_en: On a clear night the milky-way is clearly visible.

definition: the fact or quality of being extrovert; extroversion.
example_en: Everyone liked her extroversion.

definition: the act of patrolling an area, town, camp, etc.
example_en: The soldiers were patrolling at night.

definition: Sarasvati, the Goddess of Speech.
example_en: By the blessing of the Goddess of Speech, he attained knowledge.

definition: a man who is hidden or not seen.
example: ಆ ಉಳಿಕಾರ ಜನರ ಕಣ್ಣಿಗೆ ಎಂದೂ ಬೀಳಲಿಲ್ಲ.
example_en: That hidden man never came into people's sight.

definition: a man who identifies (a wild animal or person) by the footprints.
example_en: The tracker identified the tiger just by looking at the footprints.

definition: to suffer pain; to undergo affliction; to be persecuted.
example_en: The poor farmers suffered affliction from the burden of debt.

definition: to excel; to progress well.
example_en: He progressed well through hard work.

definition: a story - a) an account of imaginary or past events; a narrative, tale or anecdote; b) a fictitious literary composition in prose or poetry, shorter than a novel; narrative; tale; c) the past course of the life of a person or institution etc; d) the narrative or plot of a novel or play etc.; storyline; d) a mere tale, an account with no basis in fact.
example: ಅಜ್ಜಿ ಮಕ್ಕಳಿಗೆ ಒಂದು ಸುಂದರ ಕಥೆ ಹೇಳಿದಳು.
example_en: The grandmother told the children a beautiful story.

definition: a person who cheats or commits fraud; a cheat; a fraud.
example_en: He is a cheat; he deceives everyone.

definition: any intoxicating drink; an alcoholic liquor.
example_en: He had drunk liquor and was intoxicated.

definition: a road that is not properly laid.
example_en: The travelers hesitated to go by the badly-laid road.

definition: the act of walking.
example_en: The child's walking is still unsteady.

definition: red soil.
example: ಆ ಹೊಲದಲ್ಲಿ ಕೆಮ್ಮಣ್ ಇರುವುದರಿಂದ ಫಸಲು ಚೆನ್ನಾಗಿ ಬರುತ್ತದೆ.
example_en: Since there is red soil in that field, the crop yields well.

definition: to make new or anew; to renew.
example_en: The poet renewed his old poetic work.

definition: a reply; an answer; a rejoinder.
example_en: He gave a suitable reply to the question.

definition: to put forth an excuse or pretext.
example_en: He gave an excuse for not coming to school.

definition: a man working for wages; a wage-earner; an employee.
example_en: The wage-earner goes to work every day.

definition: knowledge of the fact; right knowledge.
example_en: He obtained right knowledge from the teacher.

definition: the pronoun of the second person singular or plural, used of the person or persons being addressed; you.
example_en: The word 'nīm' (you) was used in Old Kannada.

definition: a flower garden.
example_en: There was a beautiful flower garden in front of the house.

definition: the common rodent mousem Mus musculus that infests building; a mouse.
example_en: The mouse was gnawing at the grain in the storeroom.

definition: to string flowers to make a garland.
example_en: The garland-maker strung the flower garland for the wedding.

definition: a person trained to undertake relatively long journeys in the space.
example: ಗಗನಯಾತ್ರಿ ಚಂದ್ರನ ಮೇಲೆ ನಡೆದ ಮೊದಲ ಮನುಷ್ಯನಾದನು.
example_en: The space traveler became the first man to walk on the moon.

definition: a person professing belief in Jesus as the Christ or in the religion based on the teachings of Jesus; a Christian.
example: ಆ ಈಸಾಯಿ ಕುಟುಂಬ ಪ್ರತಿ ಭಾನುವಾರ ಚರ್ಚಿಗೆ ಹೋಗುತ್ತದೆ.
example_en: That Christian family goes to church every Sunday.

definition: to cry aloud; to shout.
example_en: The people who saw the fire shouted aloud.

definition: (gram.) an indeclinable particle i.e. a) a short, usually uninflected and invariable part of speech used to express a syntactic or semantic relationship, as an article or any of certain prepositions, conjunctions or interjections b) a prefix or derivational suffix.
example_en: In grammar, an indeclinable particle cannot be changed.

definition: any of a large and widely distributed order (Testudines) of terrestrial or aquatic reptiles having a toothless beak and a soft body encased in a tough shell into which, in most species, the head, tail, and four legs may be withdrawn; a turtle; a tortoise.
example_en: The tortoise crawled slowly towards the pond.

definition: a variety in cardamom plant; black cardamom plant.
example_en: The seeds of the black cardamom are added to curry.

definition: not having any taste; tastelessly.
example_en: The cooking turned out tasteless.

definition: an alteration or modification; a change.
example: ಕಾಲಕ್ಕೆ ತಕ್ಕಂತೆ ಆ ಪದ್ಧತಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ಕಂಚಿ ಆಯಿತು.
example_en: That custom underwent a change according to the times.

definition: quickness; swiftness.
example_en: Everyone appreciated the quickness of his work.

definition: on or during the day two days after today.
example_en: The day after tomorrow we will travel.
